title: Update ggplot2 guide syntax in weekly planner
description:
`ggweekly` was triggering the ggplot2 deprecation warning for `guides(... = FALSE)`. This change switches the package to the current `"none"` guide value so weekly planner plots render without the warning on newer ggplot2 releases.

- **Compatibility update**
  - Replace the deprecated guide suppression syntax with the supported form:
    ```r
    ggplot2::guides(fill = "none")
    ```
- **Scope**
  - Affects the weekly planner plot construction path only.
  - No user-facing behavior change beyond removing the warning.

title: Add font_base_family parameter
description: This adds a parameter for the base font family passed to theme_minimal. Also uses the font_label_text parameter for the holidays. Hard coding the PT Sans font family causes problems saving plots to PDF on Macs.
